## opencode-voice 0.11.4

Voice in and voice out for OpenCode. This release adds bilingual TTS, hands-free
conversation mode, streaming dictation with live waveform, and a full marketing
presence (landing page, brand assets, positioning doc).

### Highlights

- **VieNeu-TTS bilingual engine** (vi + en code-switching in one utterance) via
  `/tts-engine`. Per-sentence language routing so mixed-language replies sound
  right.
- **Hands-free conversation mode** (`/voice-conversation`): auto-silence finalize +
  auto-listen after reply, with barge-in and a phase-aware clickable status line.
- **Streaming dictation**: live waveform + live transcript above the prompt, with
  pause / auto-submit / auto-end toggles. Auto-end now uses audio-level silence
  detection (RMS) plus partial dedup, so whisper hallucinations no longer keep
  the timer alive.
- **Pausable recording** (SIGSTOP mic, tick-skipping) and clickable preview
  controls.
- **TTS playback controls**: pause/resume/stop/replay/rewind/forward/speed (0.75x–2x),
  now-playing line with clickable buttons.
- **LLM normalization hardening**: `sanitizeSpokenText` guard on narrator output;
  diagram/table summarization (structural label extraction).
- **Config persistence via kv** (host truncates plugin options): sttMode,
  sttAutoSubmit, ttsEngine, tts.rate, stt.autoEndOfSpeech.

### Fixes

- Diacritic-insensitive word matching for Vietnamese transcript stability.
- Stop-tail supersede fix (no more doubled text on finalize).
- VieNeu sidecar now defaults to the venv python (host-truncated options).
- v2 toast polling disabled (no stacking).
- Debug logging to `/tmp/opencode-voice-stt.log` with pid tagging.

### Marketing / distribution

- Landing page: https://bojackduy.github.io/opencode-voice/
- Brand assets: logo, favicon, OG image in `docs/`.
- `POSITIONING.md`, `MARKETING.md` (30-day content calendar + launch drafts).
- GitHub topics + repo description updated.
- npm keywords expanded.

### Tests

344 tests pass; `npm run check` clean.

### Install

```
npm i -g @bojackduy/opencode-voice
```

See README for v1 (tui.json) and v2 (cli.json) setup.
